_comment: What money buys: one thing, Supporter. Everything else - every builder, every cosmetic, every title - is earned by playing, with the keys each level pays (progression.json, keys), and Supporter changes nothing about who wins. PLACEHOLDER: nothing can be bought yet. There is no payment provider and no server to record a purchase, and the button says so.

supporter._comment: One purchase, for good. The Supporter page leads with what it is worth in all - {bonus} plus {boost} - and lists the perks; {bonus} in a perk is filled in from progression.json's supporter.bonus and {boost} from its adBoost.bonus, so the page and the XP it pays cannot disagree.
supporter.pitch: Lane Siege is made by one developer, and Supporter is the only thing it sells - every builder and every cosmetic is earned by playing. If you are enjoying it, this is the most direct way to keep it going, and it changes nothing about who wins.
perks: +{bonus} XP on every match, for good
The +{boost} XP boost always on, no ads
A Supporter badge by your name

founders._comment: The first count players to reach level are Founders, numbered #1 to #count in the order they got there: everything a Supporter has, free, for good, and the Founder star with their number in it, and the Founder title (cosmetics.json), that nobody else can get. The game server counts them (server/founderStore.ts) - it is the one place that knows who was first - and a player's device claims its number the moment its level gets there. {count} and {level} in the pitch are filled in from these. level must be one the game can reach: no higher than the top level (progression.json, keys).
founders.pitch: The first {count} players to reach level {level} become Founders: everything a Supporter gets, free and for good, and a Founder star with their number in it - #1 to #{count} - that nobody else will ever have.
